load_checkpoint: load a PyTorch checkpoint from a file or directory path onto a specified CPU or CUDA device
load_and_broadcast_checkpoint: load a checkpoint on the primary process and broadcast it to all distributed replicas
load_and_broadcast_checkpoint_list: load the first available checkpoint from a list of paths and broadcast it to all replicas
review_CHECKPOINT_FILE: review the default checkpoint filename constant checkpoint.torch used when loading from a directory
summarize_CPU_DEVICE_GPU_DEVICE: summarize the default CPU and CUDA device constants used for checkpoint loading
